title: BIOLOG validation error item
description: ADR-0004 Decision 5.3. One entry in a problem response's errors[] array. path uses the identical escapeSegment/dot-join rule as ADR-0003's redaction paths, deliberately reused rather than re-derived.

path.description: Escaped dot-joined field path (contracts/js/audit.mjs escapeSegment). An unescaped '.' is always a delimiter between two distinct fields, never a literal dot inside one.

code.description: Short snake_case machine reason specific to the field's validation rule, e.g. required, invalid_format, out_of_range, unknown_field.
